_readme: Template for ~/.secrets/mcp.json. Copy it there, keep only the servers you use, and never put a literal token in it: every secret is a ${VAR} placeholder whose value lives in ~/.config/secrets/work.env. enabled, allowedTools and personal stay in this file and are never written to a tool. Only servers with personal set to true and no ${VAR} are written to Codex, which is personal only. Servers that belong to another repo go in ~/.secrets/mcp.d/*.json instead. See mcp.md.
